clips.name: Hedge Half Light
clips.why: The hedge in the grey half-hour, slate on slate, barely moving.

clips.name: Hedge Y Light
clips.why: Same hedge, a shade more density as the frame goes up.

clips.name: Hedge Drafting
clips.why: Second octave of thin lines under thirty radii, the plate ground of an engraving.

clips.name: Hub Dark Plate
clips.why: Darkest plate in the deck so the small hub rings carry the frame alone.

clips.name: Hedge Breathing
clips.why: A busier mix makes the hedge breathe faster under the temporary spiral, never flicker.

clips.name: Hedge Busy Mix
clips.why: Peak of the build: three octaves of hedge behind the dense capture spiral.

clips.name: Hedge Before Dawn
clips.why: The plate tints a notch bluer as the sky starts to find the dew.

clips.name: Sun Over Hedge
clips.why: Plate to North Light as the sun arrives behind the web, dithered like a steel engraving.

clips.name: Bridge Line Cast
clips.why: One silk thread cast on the wind between two stems, sagging a little, shivering on the highs.

clips.name: Y Frame Triangle
clips.why: Six nested silk triangles from a point to the rim: the Y and its frame threads in one stroke.

clips.name: Thirty Radii
clips.why: One hairline through the hub cloned fifteen times around the centre: thirty numbered radii.

clips.name: Hub Left Open
clips.why: Five tight stroke rings at the centre, breathing a few percent on the kick like a load on a structure.

clips.name: Dry Spiral
clips.why: The sparse temporary spiral laid hub to rim, edge-detected into hairline silk so it reads as thread, not band.

clips.name: Capture Spiral
clips.why: Reversed and tight: the dense capture spiral that eats the dry one from rim to hub.

clips.name: Spiral Under Dew
clips.why: The finished web nearly still, tightening toward the hub on the kick under the weight of water.

clips.name: Three Torn Radii
clips.why: Three arcs with 200 degrees torn out, stepped 120 apart: what is left when she eats the web.

clips.name: Spider At Stem
clips.why: An ochre surveyor's mark on the left stem at bridge-line height, outline only, never scaled.

clips.name: Spider At Y
clips.why: She has walked to the junction of the Y; position only, same size.

clips.name: Spider On Radius
clips.why: Out along radius fourteen of thirty-two, laying the next one.

clips.name: Spider At Hub
clips.why: At dead centre on the hub rings, the one column where the builder sits on her own geometry.

clips.name: Spider At Rim
clips.why: The dry spiral is laid hub to rim, so she ends at the rim, lower right.

clips.name: Spider Home
clips.why: Capture spiral laid rim to hub, so she sits at the hub; the hatching shivers on the highs, her position never moves.

clips.name: Spider Waits
clips.why: Still at the hub under the dew, hatching slowed almost to a standstill.

clips.name: Spider Gone
clips.why: Absent on Eaten at Dawn: a plate-dark solid at five percent so the cell is filled and nothing shows on Screen.

clips.name: No Light Yet
clips.why: LIGHT is blank until Dew Load; plate-dark at five percent adds nothing.

clips.name: Lamp Unstruck
clips.why: A near-invisible silk vignette so the pad is filled but the half-hour stays grey.

clips.name: Dark Radii
clips.why: Still no lamp; the radii carry their own light.

clips.name: Dark Hub
clips.why: Quiet vignette; the hub column is the darkest moment of the walk-up.

clips.name: Not Yet Dew
clips.why: Blank by design: the dry spiral is temporary and carries no water.

clips.name: Glue Droplets
clips.why: Silk-coloured glue beads one per mm on the capture thread, faint, a pre-echo of the dew.

clips.name: Dew Load
clips.why: The one cold note: twenty by twenty dew points beading every radius at once, brightening on the highs.

clips.name: Dawn Strobe
clips.why: The sun over the hedge as a very slow silk pulse with a long fade; the off phase is clear, not black.

clips.name: Stamp Bridge Line
clips.why: Title-block ink bottom-left, revealed one character at a time like a pen crossing the page.

clips.name: Stamp Y Frame
clips.why: The order of operations as a field note.

clips.name: Stamp Radius 14
clips.why: Every radius numbered, the drafting office counting along.

clips.name: Stamp Hub Open
clips.why: The hub note while the rings sit at centre; text stays bottom-left off the figure.

clips.name: Stamp Dry Spiral
clips.why: Formwork, labelled as such before it is removed.

clips.name: Stamp Scaffold
clips.why: Column six stamps SCAFFOLD REMOVED in a stamp face, a size up, as the capture spiral eats the dry one.

clips.name: Stamp Dew Weight
clips.why: The engineering fact of the dew load, written small while the beads bloom.

clips.name: Stamp Eaten Dawn
clips.why: Left lit four bars after the BODY pad stops so the words outlive the web.

clips.name: Window Over Desk
clips.why: North Light at twenty percent: the window over the drafting table.

clips.name: Window Y Frame
clips.why: Same window, same grade; AURA never reacts.

clips.name: Window Drafting
clips.why: Slate-blue wash holding the radii cool.

clips.name: Window Hub
clips.why: A hair lower on the hub so the dark plate stays dark.

clips.name: Window Dry
clips.why: Back to twenty percent for the temporary spiral.

clips.name: Window Up Notch
clips.why: Up one notch on Capture Spiral only, as the bible asks.

clips.name: Window Dew Glass
clips.why: A North Light vignette, clear at centre, so the dew beads sit in a cool window frame.

clips.name: Dawn Warms Window
clips.why: Ochre at the top of the window to slate at the bottom: the sun finding the drawing office.

clips.name: Plate Grain
clips.why: Steel-engraving grain at six percent.

clips.name: Plate Grain Fine
clips.why: Same plate grain under the Y frame.

clips.name: Drafting Grid
clips.why: Graph paper under the numbered radii, one colour transparent, barely there.

clips.name: Engraver Hatch
clips.why: Ninety hard hairlines as an engraver's hatch over the hub, softening a touch on the highs.

clips.name: Plate Grain Dry
clips.why: Grain up a point for the temporary spiral.

clips.name: Plate Two Tone
clips.why: Two-tone static reads as a coarser plate at the peak of the build.

clips.name: Dew Grain
clips.why: Grain at eight percent so the cold dew note keeps a paper surface.

clips.name: Dawn Grain
clips.why: The foxed-paper finish on the last sheet.

clips.name: Thread Scope
clips.why: A single silk thread under tension along the bottom strip, reading the raw spectrum so everything else can be slow.

clips.name: Thread Scope
clips.why: Same scope clip, Silk, bottom strip.

clips.name: Thread Scope
clips.why: Same scope clip, Silk, bottom strip.

clips.name: Thread Scope
clips.why: Same scope clip, Silk, bottom strip.

clips.name: Thread Scope
clips.why: Same scope clip, Silk, bottom strip.

clips.name: Thread Scope
clips.why: Same scope clip, Silk, bottom strip.

clips.name: Thread Scope Dew
clips.why: Same scope clip in Dew, the only column allowed the cold note.

clips.name: Thread Scope Dawn
clips.why: Same scope clip in Ochre for the last sheet, the hand that signs the drawing.

clips.name: Funnel Sheet Slow
clips.why: Inside the funnel looking out: dim Sheet-grey tunnel lines on Funnel black, mouth drifted low-left, barely thickening on the kick.

clips.name: Sheet Knots Still
clips.why: The sheet web as a low knotted plane, Wobble at zero because nothing has landed yet.

clips.name: Spider Downstairs
clips.why: One rust point sitting low-left in the retreat: she is downstairs and does not move.

clips.name: Sodium Lamp Timer
clips.why: Sodium amber falling from the top edge into transparency, the streetlamp on its timer, dither buzzing faintly on the highs.

clips.name: Sit Wait Header
clips.why: Ash monospaced strip-chart header top-right, no glow, the deck's instruction.

clips.name: Bruise Vignette
clips.why: Ultraviolet bruise only at the edges, a quiet vignette before the full wash arrives in Twelve Days.

clips.name: Night Vision Grain
clips.why: Coarse two-tone night-vision grain, heavier than any other deck, pixelated up so it reads as 1970s film.

clips.name: Sheet Seismograph
clips.why: The one raw unsmoothed readout: an Ash pen trace low on the frame, mirrored so it reads as a seismograph of the sheet.

clips.name: Funnel Near Still
clips.why: The same funnel slowed almost to a stop and dimmed further: twelve days of nothing.

clips.name: Sheet Held Still
clips.why: Speed zero, Wobble zero: the sheet is a drumskin with nothing on it, so the SCOPE is the only thing moving.

clips.name: Slit Sensilla
clips.why: Four thin open arcs, rust and sheet grey, the slits in her legs reading the sheet; they load a few percent on the kick and never rotate.

clips.name: Lamp Off Quiet
clips.why: Stillness column: the lamp is off, a near-invisible gradient keeps the grid filled and the dark honest.

clips.name: Twelve Days Header
clips.why: Ash header top-right; the sentence ends without an object because nothing has come.

clips.name: UV Bruise Wash
clips.why: The ultraviolet band the spider sees and you do not, 15 percent, arriving with the wait.

clips.name: Drum Paper Grid
clips.why: Still graph paper on the recorder drum instead of moving grain, so only the pen trace moves in this column.

clips.name: Trace Alone Centre
clips.why: Same scope clip moved to dead centre: in Twelve Days it is the only thing moving, so let it own the frame.

clips.name: Funnel Tightens
clips.why: The funnel wakes slightly; lines thicken on the kick like a load coming onto silk.

clips.name: Sheet Shivers
clips.why: Wobble bound to the highs for the first time: the silk shivers and says something landed.

clips.name: The Thing Landed
clips.why: A single sheet-grey point, the prey, twitching on the far side with a short trail; its weight on the sheet swells on the kick.

clips.name: Lamp Off Tremor
clips.why: Stillness column: no strobe, no lamp, nearly invisible so the first tremor is read not seen.

clips.name: Tremor Timestamp
clips.why: The recorder stamps the time of the first vibration in ash monospace.

clips.name: UV Bruise Tremor
clips.why: Ultraviolet wash held at 15 percent; nothing on AURA reacts.

clips.name: Grain Tremor
clips.why: Two-tone night-vision grain back at its resting 12 percent.

clips.name: Seismograph Trace
clips.why: Scope returns to the bottom strip so the tremor reads as a pen excursion under the figure.

clips.name: Funnel Bearing
clips.why: Funnel a touch brighter and denser as she brings her attention up; structural tension on the lows only.

clips.name: Bearing Lines Quad
clips.why: The sheet angled 25 degrees and quad-mirrored so the knotted lines cross from four bearings: triangulation drawn in silk.

clips.name: Rust Body Bearing
clips.why: The spider surfaces as a heavy-outlined rust body, offset upper-right on the bearing she has read; only her hatching shivers on the highs, never her position.

clips.name: Sodium Lamp Cone
clips.why: The streetlamp timer clicks back on: sodium amber from the top edge, steady, no reaction.

clips.name: Listen With Feet
clips.why: How she triangulates: the header names the instrument.

clips.name: UV Bruise Bearing
clips.why: Ultraviolet wash continues unchanged under the amber lamp.

clips.name: Grain Bearing
clips.why: Resting night-vision grain.

clips.name: Trace Triangulate
clips.why: Same scope, bottom strip, Ash.

clips.name: Funnel Taut
clips.why: The funnel pulled taut; each kick is a load on the structure, released over 400 ms.

clips.name: The Plucked Thread
clips.why: One sheet-grey thread across the frame, Waves 1, modulation depth high: the line she plucks; depth rides the lows, the silk fuzz rides the highs.

clips.name: It Answers
clips.why: Two grey points struggling on the far side with short trails: the prey answers the pluck, and a busier mix makes it struggle faster.

clips.name: Foreleg Strike
clips.why: Strike white flash with a transparent off phase, played by hand in a two-then-pause rhythm; never clocked, never on the FFT.

clips.name: Pluck Listen
clips.why: The foreleg's instruction in ash, slightly larger as the decision approaches.

clips.name: UV Bruise Pluck
clips.why: Ultraviolet wash held.

clips.name: Grain Pluck
clips.why: Grain a hair heavier as the recorder pen starts working.

clips.name: Trace Pluck
clips.why: Same scope, bottom strip, Ash, reading the pluck and the answer.

clips.name: Funnel Collapse
clips.why: The funnel rushes past at speed, brighter and denser, and a busy mix pushes the rush faster without flicker.

clips.name: Sheet Rushes
clips.why: Wobble high, height tall, a baked mild Displace so the sheet collapses and re-forms as she crosses it; lows heave the height, highs tear at the wobble.

clips.name: Rust Body Rush
clips.why: The body at its largest, grainy and heavy-outlined, streaking long rust trails low-right at the prey: rush in 0.3 seconds.

clips.name: Rush Strike
clips.why: Strike white a little faster and brighter for the drop, still a pad under a finger, transparent between flashes.

clips.name: Rush Countdown
clips.why: Largest ash header of the deck, still top-right, still unreactive so it reads on a wall at 2am.

clips.name: UV Bruise Rush
clips.why: Last column of the ultraviolet band before it goes off.

clips.name: Pen Skids Grain
clips.why: Grain cranked to 40 percent and coarsened: the recorder pen skids across the drum for one scene.

clips.name: Trace Rush White
clips.why: Same scope clip recoloured Strike white for the peak only.

clips.name: Funnel Spun
clips.why: The funnel twisted around its centre as she rotates the prey; silk loads on the kick.

clips.name: Swathing Spiral
clips.why: One tight sheet-grey leaf spinning up: the swathing band winding around the prey, faster with the mids, bent by the lows.

clips.name: Rotate And Wrap
clips.why: Five rust bodies cloned around the spiral's centre: the spider seen at every point of her circuit as she rotates and wraps.

clips.name: Wrap Strike
clips.why: Slower, softer strike white for the wrapping, still hand-played.

clips.name: Rotate Wrap Header
clips.why: Ash header back to working size as the action becomes procedure.

clips.name: Bruise Off Swathe
clips.why: The ultraviolet band is off here; a 3 percent ghost keeps the cell filled without colouring anything.

clips.name: Grain Swathe
clips.why: Grain back to resting 12 percent after the skid.

clips.name: Trace Swathe
clips.why: Same scope, bottom strip, back to Ash.

clips.name: Funnel Black
clips.why: The bible's swap: the funnel is no longer drawn, only Funnel black remains under the husk.

clips.name: Sheet Goes Still
clips.why: Line Scape still and empty: no knots, no speed, almost flat, half-faded sheet grey.

clips.name: Husk Outline
clips.why: Rust outline only with a transparent fill, centred and still: a body with nothing in it.

clips.name: Lamp Off Husk
clips.why: No light on the husk; near-invisible filler keeps the dark honest.

clips.name: Contact Lost Red
clips.why: The deck's one red, used once: the header turns Contact red and the room is left with one word, static and the trace.

clips.name: Bruise Off Husk
clips.why: Ultraviolet band off; 3 percent ghost so the grid has no hole.

clips.name: Grain Husk
clips.why: Grain stays up with TEXT and SCOPE when every other fader is pulled.

clips.name: Trace Alone Husk
clips.why: Same scope moved back to centre, mirroring Twelve Days: the trace is again the only thing moving, and you stay there longer than the room expects.

clips.name: Cloth Ground
clips.why: Walnut-on-walnut warp and weft a hair apart: the lamp-lit gallery cloth the whole deck sits on.

clips.name: Gilt Loom
clips.why: The loom itself, 8x8 gilt and Tyrian, the pad you alternate against Gods' Crimes so the weave flips under your fingers.

clips.name: Woman At Loom
clips.why: Arachne as a tall narrow Tyrian silhouette with a heavy gilt outline, squashed on one axis so she reads as a seated woman.

clips.name: Lamplight Sweep
clips.why: Gallery halogen raking across the cloth from one side, gilt fading to nothing.

clips.name: Idmon's Daughter

params.Text:
IDMON'S DAUGHTER
HER FATHER DYED WOOL

clips.why: The catalogue card for the first exhibit, Linen on the lower edge like a museum label.

clips.name: Telecine Warmth
clips.why: A gilt telecine wash so the whole scene is 16mm warm rather than video cold.

clips.name: Warp Grid
clips.why: A fine linen graph-paper mesh: the thread count of the cloth, barely there.

clips.name: Shuttle Thread
clips.why: The one raw unsmoothed readout: a Linen thread in the shuttle that the music plucks.

clips.name: Warp Ground
clips.why: Same walnut cloth ground so the BODY flip between columns 1 and 2 happens on a steady floor.

clips.name: Vesica Tapestry
clips.why: The tapestry of the gods' crimes: twelve vesica threads, gilt inside and Tyrian outside, with the highs lifting the bloom like a shimmer on silk.

clips.name: Weaver Seated
clips.why: The same woman at the same loom; only the hatching shivers on the highs while she works without a flaw.

clips.name: Halogen Pool
clips.why: A single gallery lamp pooled on the tapestry, its dither grain fizzing on the hi-hats.

clips.name: No Flaw Label

params.Text:
WOVE THE GODS' CRIMES
NO FLAW IN THE CLOTH
DO NOT TOUCH THE WORK

clips.why: The exhibit label moves to the top edge and ends with the museum's own warning.

clips.name: Gilt Vignette
clips.why: Gold at the frame edges, clear in the middle: the gilt frame around the cloth.

clips.name: Telecine Dirt
clips.why: Coarse colour grain at 14 percent: 16mm telecine dirt, the one deck allowed colour in its grain.

clips.name: Shuttle Thread
clips.why: Same scope clip, dropped to the lower half because the label sits at the top here.

clips.name: Athena's Night
clips.why: Walnut centre falling to Woad at the edges: the night the goddess arrives from.

clips.name: Hexagon Cloth
clips.why: The finished cloth at 24 hexagonal threads, tightening a few percent on the kick like a load on a structure; this is what the Kaleidoscope buttons fold.

clips.name: Weaver Struck
clips.why: The same woman, hatching faster now, her gilt outline thickening on each kick as the shuttle lands.

clips.name: Flying Shuttle
clips.why: One fast gilt point thrown across the frame: the shuttle in flight, hurrying when the mix gets busy.

clips.name: Shuttle Struck

params.Text:
THE SHUTTLE STRUCK HER
ATHENA TORE IT

clips.why: Two lines of the blow, back on the lower edge, Linen so it reads at 2am.

clips.name: Woad Night
clips.why: The gilt warmth gives way to a Woad wash: the century turns cold when Athena enters.

clips.name: Coarse Dirt
clips.why: The telecine dirt gets coarser as the print runs toward the tear.

clips.name: Shuttle Thread
clips.why: Same scope, upper half, clear of the lower label.

clips.name: Verdict Night
clips.why: The same Woad night, its dither crawling on the highs so the dark itself feels unsteady under the verdict.

clips.name: Folded Cloth
clips.why: The same hexagon cloth folded in on itself by a baked Kaleidoscope: the tapestry crumpled in Athena's fist, ready for the Fragment button to tear it.

clips.name: Weaver Condemned
clips.why: The woman stands completely still under the verdict, outline heaviest here, nothing reacting.

clips.name: Madder Strobe
clips.why: The one madder strobe of the deck, slow and long-faded, held under a finger while the verdict reads.

clips.name: Verdict Hang
clips.why: The only text allowed dead centre: the sentence stamped in madder across the woman herself.

clips.name: Athena Vignette
clips.why: Woad closing in from the edges: the night behind the goddess tightening around the frame.

clips.name: Torn Grain
clips.why: Harsh two-tone grain, coarsest of the deck: the print damaged at the frame where the cloth tears.

clips.name: Shuttle Thread
clips.why: Same scope, lower half, below the centred verdict.

clips.name: Loom Ground
clips.why: Back to the walnut cloth ground: the gallery lights come up again after the verdict.

clips.name: Hanging Thread
clips.why: One gilt thread through the centre, the thread she hangs from, thickening under load on the kick and shivering on the highs.

clips.name: Spider Octagon
clips.why: The cut: the same Tyrian shape at the same place, now cloned eight ways into an octagonal spider with no transition.

clips.name: Light From Above
clips.why: Gilt light from the top edge only, falling down the thread onto the hanged weaver.

clips.name: Live But Hang

params.Text:
LIVE. BUT HANG.
HER HAIR FELL OUT
SPIN, FOREVER

clips.why: The sentence commuted, three short lines on the lower edge in Linen, the HANG no longer in madder.

clips.name: Dye Bath
clips.why: Gilt at the top sinking into Tyrian at the bottom: the father's dye bath she is lowered into.

clips.name: Thread Weft
clips.why: A hundred faint linen threads parallel to the hanging one: the web she will spin, not yet visible as a web.

clips.name: Shuttle Thread
clips.why: Same scope, upper half, crossing the hanging thread.

clips.name: Gourd Of Stories
clips.why: Walnut centre to a gilt rim: the sky god's gourd that holds every story, lit from behind.

clips.name: Circle Tapestry
clips.why: The myth changes continent: eight concentric circle threads, the kente-like round weave, breathing a few percent outward on the kick.

clips.name: Ananse Descends
clips.why: A three-leafed Tyrian spiral bent hard by distortion: Ananse climbing down his thread to Nyame, turning faster when the mix is busy.

clips.name: Sky God Lamps
clips.why: Three soft gilt lamps drifting slowly, the sky god's light, swelling slightly on the low end.

clips.name: Nyame's Receipt

params.Text:
NYAME NAMES THE PRICE
SKY GOD: RECEIPT

clips.why: The Anansi labels switch to the BBC Schools sans: a museum caption for the bargain, on the top edge.

clips.name: Gourd Glow
clips.why: A gilt glow in the centre of the frame only: warmth from inside the gourd.

clips.name: Gallery Dust
clips.why: The telecine dirt eases back to a lighter dust as the second myth begins.

clips.name: Shuttle Thread
clips.why: Same scope, recoloured gilt for the Ananse columns, lower half under the top label.

clips.name: Node Ground
clips.why: The walnut cloth ground returns so the story nodes float on the gallery floor.

clips.name: Story Circles
clips.why: The same circle weave opened wider, its intersections brightening on the highs: nodes on the web where stories are kept.

clips.name: Spider Waits
clips.why: The eight-fold Tyrian spider at the hub, its grain shivering on the highs while the captures are paid.

clips.name: Four Captures
clips.why: Four gilt orbs held perfectly still for payment, python, leopard, hornets, fairy, swelling only on the low end.

clips.name: Onini Lands
clips.why: The first capture name drops onto the web letter by letter, upper left, a pad to mash as the beam passes each node.

clips.name: Halogen Warmth
clips.why: The gilt telecine wash again so the nodes read warm against the walnut.

clips.name: Field Speckle
clips.why: A single-octave speckle field, dense and faint: dew on the web, thickening on the highs.

clips.name: Shuttle Thread
clips.why: Same gilt scope, upper half, clear of the top-left capture name.

clips.name: Web Ground
clips.why: The cloth ground one last time: warp and weft under the cosmogram.

clips.name: Ananse Cosmogram
clips.why: Eight fine stroked rings with a small gap stepping 45 degrees per ring so the gaps spiral into spokes: the Ananse cosmology diagram, tightening a few percent on the kick.

clips.name: Spider At Hub
clips.why: The same spider at the hub of the web with trails baked in, so every grain flicker leaves silk behind it.

clips.name: Sweep Beam
clips.why: A single filled ring opened to a sixty-degree gilt wedge: the storyteller's beam frozen on one node, to be swept by the Bank A Radar knob.

clips.name: Osebo Lands
clips.why: The second capture lands at the opposite node, lower right, so mashing columns 7 and 8 drops names onto the web one by one.

clips.name: Sky Sweep Wash
clips.why: An angular wash from gilt round to Woad: the sky god's sky turning once behind the web.

clips.name: Web Mesh
clips.why: A faint gilt mesh: the silk between the spokes, nearly invisible until the beam passes.

clips.name: Shuttle Thread
clips.why: Same gilt scope, lower half, the thread in the shuttle running out as the deck ends.

clips.name: Linen Lantern
clips.why: The only light ground in the instrument: Lantern centre to Lamp edge, dimmed so the Add and Screen layers above have headroom instead of blowing to white.

clips.name: Sac Wall Silk
clips.why: The wound silk of the sac wall, a low soft sheet in Lamp that only the highs make shiver.

clips.name: The Clutch
clips.why: Sixteen still eggs held tight; Screen can only lighten, so the clutch reads backlit cream through the linen rather than ink.

clips.name: First Light Pulse
clips.why: A lamp breathing through the sac wall, a pulse not a strobe, with the off phase clear.

clips.name: Sac Log One

params.Text:
sac spun in one night
guarded until frost
quiet please

clips.why: Darwin's pencil in the lower-left margin; a hairline Nursery Ink edge keeps it readable on the light ground.

clips.name: Lamp Corners
clips.why: Overlay vignette: nearly nothing at the centre, Nursery Ink darkening the corners the way Multiply would have.

clips.name: Lamplight Dust
clips.why: Dust drifting in lamplight, the field broken into fine dots instead of 16mm grain for the opening only.

clips.name: Pencil Heartbeat
clips.why: The one raw unsmoothed trace in the deck, faded to 40% so it reads as a heartbeat, held in a band away from the margin note.

clips.name: Linen Lantern II
clips.why: Same linen ground, a touch brighter as the room fills.

clips.name: Inside The Sac
clips.why: Looking out from inside the wound silk: concentric Lamp lines drifting very slowly, thickening a hair on the kick.

clips.name: The Huddle
clips.why: The grid climbs from 4 toward 20: a hundred-odd hatchlings pressed together, their edges shivering on the highs.

clips.name: Sac Dew
clips.why: Four hundred dew points on the sac, brightening with the highs only.

clips.name: Three Hundred Log

params.Text:
three hundred inside
hatch. huddle. wait.

clips.why: The sac log, two lines in the margin, no glow.

clips.name: Lamp Wash
clips.why: Amber lamp through linen, 18% Overlay warming the whole plate.

clips.name: Sixteen Mil Grain
clips.why: Heavy 1979 natural-history grain, a lead character in this deck.

clips.name: Pencil Heartbeat
clips.why: Same scope clip, Pencil, same band.

clips.name: Warm Linen
clips.why: The warmest ground of the deck for the scene where the mother is the structure.

clips.name: The Mother
clips.why: One large soft body, Lantern fill at reduced alpha with a Lamp outline, breathing very slowly under Goo; stop this pad and leave the children.

clips.name: The Walkers
clips.why: The spiderlings now walking, leaving short silk paths; the Suckr on Bank C draws them in toward the mother below.

clips.name: Warmed Dew
clips.why: Dew with a baked halo: the lantern warmed, so the points glow rather than prick.

clips.name: Mother's Note

params.Text:
she does not leave
the mother is the meal

clips.why: The tenderest line in the corpus, kept small and lower case in the margin.

clips.name: Deep Lamp Corners
clips.why: Corners darkened a little further for the peak of the nursery, the eye held on the mother.

clips.name: Heavy Grain
clips.why: Grain at its heaviest where the plate is warmest.

clips.name: Pencil Heartbeat
clips.why: Same scope clip, Pencil, same band.

clips.name: Linen Fading
clips.why: The ground begins to dim toward the dark columns.

clips.name: Moult Silk Sheet
clips.why: The silk sheet again, tilted higher and lower, wobbling faster only when the mix is busy.

clips.name: The Exuvia
clips.why: An exact ghost of herself: outline only, no fill, hatched noise high so the edge is a body with nothing in it; tap twice on the break.

clips.name: Thin Dew
clips.why: Fewer, finer dew points, nearly still, softening on the highs.

clips.name: Moult Note
clips.why: One line only, the quietest note in the deck.

clips.name: Lamp Wash Low
clips.why: The amber grade eased back as the light goes.

clips.name: Moult Grain
clips.why: 16mm grain, unchanged, the film keeps running.

clips.name: Pencil Heartbeat
clips.why: Same scope clip, Pencil, same band.

clips.name: Last Linen
clips.why: The last of the light ground before the Offing.

clips.name: Walking Out
clips.why: The silk drifting the other way, a little jagged, as she walks out soft.

clips.name: Old Skin Stays
clips.why: The shed skin hanging in long trails; no reactivity, because the exuvia does not move.

clips.name: Softening Dew
clips.why: Dew gone soft-edged and averaged, the last wet thing on the sac.

clips.name: Engineers Note

params.Text:
the old skin stays
300 small engineers

clips.why: The log turns from the one left behind to the three hundred about to leave.

clips.name: Lamp Corners II
clips.why: Corners darkened once more; the Nursery Ink edge leads the eye toward the dark columns.

clips.name: Ecdysis Grain
clips.why: Grain eased slightly so the exuvia trails stay clean.

clips.name: Pencil Heartbeat
clips.why: Same scope clip, Pencil, same band.

clips.name: Offing
clips.why: The ground goes dark: the outside of the sac, the night at the top of the fence post.

clips.name: Sixty Threads Up
clips.why: Sixty hairline threads thrown straight up in Lantern, now the gossamer colour; the highs make them shiver, the Bank C Displace does the rest.

clips.name: Tiptoe Dispersal
clips.why: Four hundred small warm bodies high in frame, abdomens to the wind; Lamp because Nursery Ink under Screen on Offing would be a dim brown.

clips.name: Sky Field Lines
clips.why: Sky voltage 100 v/m drawn as thin alternating arcs of the electric field the spiderlings are about to use.

clips.name: Tiptoe Note

params.Text:
tiptoe
abdomen to the wind
sky voltage 100 v/m

clips.why: Pencil reads cleanly on Offing, so the outline is dropped from here on.

clips.name: Morning Hint
clips.why: A first cold hint of Morning cooling the silk highlights, nearly invisible on the dark ground.

clips.name: Night Grain
clips.why: Grain a touch heavier for the night exterior, pushed-film look.

clips.name: Pencil Heartbeat
clips.why: Same scope clip, Pencil now slate on dark.

clips.name: Sixty Miles Dark
clips.why: Offing deepening toward the edges, the sea at night sixty miles out.

clips.name: Threads In Wind
clips.why: Fewer threads, bending slowly in a baked wind, thickening a hair on the kick as the load comes on the line.

clips.name: Sailing On Nothing
clips.why: The dispersal at its widest and fastest, each body trailing its own line of silk.

clips.name: Sky Swell
clips.why: A slow swell of the sky field, Lantern breathing over the dark, never a flash.

clips.name: Balloon Note

params.Text:
silk up, feet off
they sail on nothing
never see each other

clips.why: Three lines for the letting go.

clips.name: Morning Hint II
clips.why: The same cold hint, holding until the sky opens.

clips.name: Night Grain II
clips.why: Night grain, unchanged.

clips.name: Pencil Heartbeat
clips.why: Same scope clip, Pencil, same band.

clips.name: Sky Opening
clips.why: Offing to Morning, the first open air in the deck, dimmed so the rigging stays legible against it.

clips.name: Silk Rigging
clips.why: A hundred soft lines mirrored into a crossing lattice: the Beagle's rigging coated in silk.

clips.name: Landfall Unknown
clips.why: The spiderlings at their most scattered and smallest, gone the colour of gossamer, drifting the full frame.

clips.name: Lighthouse
clips.why: A slow Lantern pulse swept by a baked searchlight: the lighthouse turning while every other fader comes down over eight bars.

clips.name: Beagle Log

params.Text:
beagle. 60 miles out.
rigging coated in silk
gossamer: goose summer

clips.why: Darwin's log closing on the word that names the deck.

clips.name: Morning Wash
clips.why: Morning at its fullest as an Overlay, cooling the silk lattice and the lighthouse.

clips.name: Sea Grain
clips.why: Harsher two-tone grain at lower opacity, sea air on the emulsion.

clips.name: Pencil Heartbeat
clips.why: Same scope clip, the trace turned Morning for the only column with open sky.

clips.name: Housing Black
clips.why: The coldest ground in the pack: radar-scope housing, nearly black so every layer above reads on Add.

clips.name: Range Rings Idle
clips.why: Eight hairline range rings in P7 green, the trace the beam leaves; the strand thickens under load on the kick and relaxes between hits.

clips.name: Carrier Line
clips.why: An unmodulated carrier: a near-flat signal-white hairline in the upper third that only takes modulation when the mix gets busy.

clips.name: Sweep Edge Idle
clips.why: The antenna sweep as an angular fade from tape-reel amber to nothing, dim because the station is only idling; highs shiver the trail's grain.

clips.name: Ident Station 7
clips.why: The station ident in 1981 continuity sans, signal white, parked in the top band so it never sits on the carrier.

clips.name: Scope Glass Wash
clips.why: Scope-glass teal at low opacity grades the whole picture cold without washing it out.

clips.name: Tube Snow
clips.why: A touch of two-tone snow so the tube reads as a tube, not a render.

clips.name: Scope Carrier
clips.why: The one literal readout: a phosphor oscilloscope on the raw unsmoothed spectrum, centred, so everything else can afford to be slow.

clips.name: Glass Fog
clips.why: The scope glass fogs slightly as the sweep starts: grey field tinted between housing and glass teal, breathing faster when the mix is busy.

clips.name: Sweep Arcs
clips.why: The same eight rings broken open into staggered arcs, the returns a sweep leaves behind; mash these pads on the beat so a ring lands where the beam is.

clips.name: Phosphor Returns
clips.why: A handful of signal-white contacts drifting slowly with long trails: P7 phosphor holds three seconds, and each blip swells a little on the kick.

clips.name: Sweep Edge
clips.why: The beam's leading edge at full strength now: hard amber seam fading round the dial; the period is the clock so nothing but grain reacts.

clips.name: Hour In Eighths
clips.why: One revolution per bar, one leg per beat: the caption in the lower band under the sweep.

clips.name: Glass Vignette
clips.why: Clear in the centre, scope-glass teal at the rim: the dial's bezel as a radial wash.

clips.name: Scanlines
clips.why: 270 faint horizontal rows: CRT scanlines instead of snow, so Sweep feels like a monitor rather than film.

clips.name: Scope Sweep
clips.why: Same phosphor scope, centred, the literal readout under the sweep.

clips.name: Housing Still
clips.why: Back to a dead-still housing black so a single strand of silk can be the whole picture.

clips.name: Vertical Strand
clips.why: One hairline of signal white, the vertical strand of a surveyor's reticle; highs make it shiver and never tear.

clips.name: Horizontal Strand
clips.why: The crossing strand on FIGURE so two layers make one reticle at dead centre; same shiver, same silk.

clips.name: Reel Rim Faint
clips.why: The bible leaves LIGHT blank here, so a nearly invisible amber rim keeps the cell filled without lighting the reticle.

clips.name: Reticle Strand
clips.why: Caption in the lower band, clear of the crosshair's centre.

clips.name: Glass Wash Silk
clips.why: The teal grade a hair lower so the two white strands stay the brightest thing on the wall.

clips.name: Tube Snow Fine
clips.why: Snow kept fine and faint so it does not compete with a hairline.

clips.name: Scope Reticle
clips.why: Same scope dropped to the lower quarter so it does not cross the horizontal strand.

clips.name: Lit From Below
clips.why: Housing black lifting a few steps toward steel-grey on one edge: Maman is lit from the floor, so the ground is not flat.

clips.name: Eight Radii Steel
clips.why: The spoke trick: fifty 4-degree arcs stepped 45 degrees each make eight dotted radii converging overhead, her legs seen from the floor; they tense on the kick.

clips.name: Maman Octagon
clips.why: An enormous eight-sided steel outline cut from a solid by two octagon masks, pushed off centre so it looms from above; the housing shows through as her body and nothing reacts because she decides where she is.

clips.name: Marble Eggs
clips.why: Nine held marble eggs, speed zero, blooming softly in the sac above her; only their edges shiver with the highs.

clips.name: Maman Caption

params.Text:
MAMAN: NINE METRES
MARBLE EGGS, HELD

clips.why: Two lines in the lower band like a museum label, under the octagon.

clips.name: Steel Underlight
clips.why: A vertical wash from clear to matte steel: the underlighting on her stainless, cold against the phosphor.

clips.name: Tube Snow Maman
clips.why: The same ten percent snow so the steel reads matte, not clean.

clips.name: Scope Maman
clips.why: Same scope pushed down to the floor under her, where the dance floor is.

clips.name: Housing Clock
clips.why: Flat housing black again: two clocks need a still ground to disagree on.

clips.name: Range Rings Tick
clips.why: The eight range rings return as the dial face; the spacing loads a few percent on the kick like a structure, not a flash.

clips.name: Eight Hands
clips.why: Forty-eight dots stepped 45 degrees: eight dotted hands and no face, six dots each, in signal white; a clock does not react.

clips.name: CP1919 Pulse
clips.why: A slow amber tick with a short fade, the pulsar's 1.337 s period against the eight-beat sweep; off phase transparent so the black stays black.

clips.name: Not A Signal
clips.why: The Bell Burnell line, 22 characters at size 1, in the top band above the hands.

clips.name: Glass Wash Clock
clips.why: Scope-glass teal grade, unchanged, so the amber tick is the only warmth.

clips.name: Scanlines Tick
clips.why: Scanlines rather than snow: the pulsar was found on a chart recorder, a ruled page.

clips.name: Scope Eighths
clips.why: Same scope centred across the hands, the third clock in the room.

clips.name: Glass Dome
clips.why: Housing black in the centre to scope-glass teal at the edge: the dome from inside, the peak's deepest ground.

clips.name: Orb Web
clips.why: Twenty-eight hairline circles nested off-centre and bunching outward like a spiral thread: the orb web the sweep traced, phosphor fading to signal white, its bloom alone on the highs.

clips.name: Four Vanes
clips.why: The same dotted-spoke trick at 90 degrees: the four vanes that hold the secondary mirror, etched over the web, tensing slightly on the kick.

clips.name: Dew Returns
clips.why: Four hundred tiny dew points across the net, bloomed so each catches a cross of light; highs shiver them, lows swell them a hair.

clips.name: Shadow On Star
clips.why: The peak's line in the lower band, under the vanes and the dew.

clips.name: Dome Vignette
clips.why: The strongest teal rim in the deck, clear at the centre so the web's hub stays bright.

clips.name: Tube Snow Net
clips.why: Ten percent snow keeps the dew from looking like vector art.

clips.name: Scope Net
clips.why: Same scope centred through the hub of the web at the peak.

clips.name: True Black
clips.why: A legitimate black, not housing blue: the station has lost contact.

clips.name: Dark Body Quiet
clips.why: The bible says Blank; a five percent housing tint on Add is invisible and keeps the grid without a hole.

clips.name: Dark Figure Quiet
clips.why: Blank per the bible: black on Screen adds nothing, so the figure is simply gone.

clips.name: Warn Beacon
clips.why: The only red light in the pack: a slow, dim blackout lamp under a finger, never a signal path.

clips.name: No Contact 0300
clips.why: Warn red, dead centre like a continuity caption, because there is nothing else on the wall to sit on.

clips.name: Aura Off
clips.why: The grade is off on Blackout; a near-zero black overlay fills the cell and changes nothing.

clips.name: Alive Black
clips.why: GRAIN stays and comes up a little so the black is alive, not off.

clips.name: Scope Blackout
clips.why: Same phosphor scope, dropped just under the red words: the only thing left alive on Blackout.

clips.name: Test Card 1981
clips.why: The closedown: a test card with the real clock showing, through a half-strength CRT so the tube is already starting to curve toward a dot.

clips.name: Body Off
clips.why: Blank per the bible; an invisible housing tint keeps the cell filled over the test card.

clips.name: Figure Off
clips.why: Nobody in the room at sign off; black on Screen is nothing.

clips.name: Reel Lift Faint
clips.why: Blank per the bible; three percent amber on Add is a breath of warmth on the card, nothing more.

clips.name: Closedown Card
clips.why: Two lines dead centre over the card with a thin housing outline so the white reads over the colour bars; then stop, no fade, like 1981 television.

clips.name: Grade Off
clips.why: The test card is its own grade; five percent teal fills the cell without touching it.

clips.name: Scanlines Close
clips.why: Scanlines over the card: the last picture is a broadcast, not a render.

clips.name: Scope Sign Off
clips.why: Same scope gone signal white and dropped under the caption: the trace going to white before the tube collapses.
